parsed.explanation: The quote is verbatim and correctly read as a target shape, not a construction. Section 2 never proves Theorem C for all n: the induction in the case μ ≥ τ collapses (the text itself flags 'This appears contradictory unless...'), the 'dual logic' paragraph needs D(R) ≥ μ−1 with no argument and contains corrupted inequalities, and the pairing strategy's budget claim ('the residual number of cuts required is at most n') is asserted without proof — from an uncut stick the stated equipartition of 2n+1 parts requires 2n cuts. The 'binary greedy' paragraph is hand-waved ('depth of the recursion is at most n'), and the section closes with n = 1, 2 checks only; Section 3's tightness remark handles only the power-of-two partition. No all-n upper bound exists anywhere in the text, so the ≤ direction of c_n is unestablished; the objection is correct and load-bearing.
